en: Hey, {player}! I was looking forward to seeing you here.
While you were busy out there, I beat the Elite Four. That makes me the new Pokémon League Champion!
I've built the perfect team. Strong against every type, ready for anything. Nobody can touch us.
And now I get to prove it against you, of all people. {player}! I'm the strongest trainer in the world!
NO! That can't be! You beat my best?
After all that work to get here... my reign is over already? It's not fair!
So you've won! Congratulations! You are the new Pokémon League Champion!
You've grown so much since the day you left Pallet Town with that first Pokémon of yours. You truly came of age!
{rival}... I'm disappointed in you. Do you know why you lost?
You forgot to treat your Pokémon with trust and love. Without that, you will never become the best.
{player}, come with me. There is a room ahead where your victory will be kept for all time.
Go on, then. Don't keep the old man waiting.
